_about: Story texts for the judges' showcase (http://127.0.0.1:8765/show). Dani edits this file; the page re-reads it every minute, no restart needed. Live numbers come from the dashboard's /api/data. In headlines, {name} is replaced by a live value: {rank}, {score}, {teams}, {session}, {ours_total}, {deal_pct}, {field_pct}, {lost_pct}. Never put a price we might use in the room, our cash floor or anything from .env here. Design: Figma file 'Team 5 · Judges showcase' (https://www.figma.com/design/picVx0KcLHR9uY0ctMuVTu).

loop.headline: Every loss we measured became a rule, and most rules became code with a test.

cards.title: Autoflip overpaid a dealer
cards.measured: MAL-07 bought at 29, worth 17.5 to us: −11.8 neg_points
cards.rule: Never buy from a dealer above our value
cards.enforced: Code: autoflip retired; the ladder mode never pays above value

cards.title: We fed a rival
cards.measured: Sold SAL-06 to a team that collects SAL: it went 15.5 → 23.7 and passed us
cards.rule: Page-closing cards only to teams ≥ 10 points below us, never to the top 4
cards.enforced: Code: the SELL filter in tools/opportunities.py and the dashboard's sell table

cards.title: A trade on our venue destroyed value
cards.measured: A buyer who doesn't collect the set traded on our 0 % venue: market points +4.99 → −5.2, #3 → #7
cards.rule: Trades on our venue must be buys by collectors
cards.enforced: The Operator: our asks go only to collectors of the set

cards.title: A duel left points on the table
cards.measured: Duel 181: the rival's offer was inside our limit and no deal closed: ≈ 10.6 P lost
cards.rule: Accept any in-limit offer before the deadline
cards.enforced: Code: the duelist accepts an in-limit offer by 2 ticks left, with a test
